about: Native generateContent bodies of the app's Gemini adapter (packages/providers/src/gemini-generate.ts geminiGenerateContentBody). `sent` is the adapter's own output, byte for byte, for the cases in tests/unit/preview-google-gate.test.ts (that test rebuilds every one); `refused` are bodies the adapter never sends and the wire contract forbids (an empty text part included). The gate's GoogleProfile.body_valid (on the {model, request} frame) and the app's guarded fetch must accept every `sent` body and refuse every `refused` one. Read by tests/unit/preview-google-gate.test.ts and tests/unit/preview_budget_authority_google_test.py.
